Single Acting Spring Hinges

Single acting door spring hinges (door swings one way) are used when you need a door to close automatically.

Single action spring door hinges from leading manufactures including Deltana, Bommer and Global Door Controls. These steel and stainless steel spring hinges are available in 3 1/2 inches, 4 inches and 4 1/2 inches with square corners, 1/4 radius corners and 5/8 radius corners.
